name: Slamming Gate
description: The heavy gate slams shut when opened more than halfway
disable: DC 15 Thievery check (trained) to loosen the gate's springs before it slams closed
reset: The trap can be reactivated (or deactivated, if it's active) by flipping a lever hidden in the nearby wall. A character Searching the area finds it with a successful DC 18 Perception check.

offensiveAbilities.name: Slam Shut
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger The door is opened more than halfway

Effect The door slams shut and deals 3d8 bludgeoning damage to any creature in the way (DC 17 basic Reflex save). On a critical failure, the creature is also Restrained by the closed door until it Escapes (DC 17)
